attribution.prior_proof: Mikko Nyman, building on Vincent Liu.
attribution.native_contribution: The positive and negative root lattices can be stated using H.rt0 and -H.rt0.
attribution.source_implementation: Codex combined the disjointness and span simplification with a shared signed-lattice cancellation argument. The genuine Fortytwo root calculation and public Mikko Nyman / Vincent Liu mathematics are retained. Codex recovered the full period and generator parameters from their dependent types in the frozen IsPure definition. The common notation expands the span of the entire family and of both signed subfamilies over the ring of integers. Codex applied the two cancellation directions for an additive subgroup to the signed summands directly. Codex converted purity of the positive and negative generators into inclusions of their spans in the corresponding signed lattices. Normalizing the composed families lets the decomposition use those inclusions directly. Codex introduced the applicable signed membership condition before normalizing the spans. Closure of each submodule under natural multiples then proves both projection cases with the same rule.
